title: Kona Blue documents admit capability to implant false memories

tellings.quote: In those documents, the United States government is admitting they have the capability to give you false memories, mess with your brain, make you do things, and that's without drugs.

plain: Papers from Kona Blue, a proposed US government programme on UFOs, admit that the government can give people false memories, tamper with their brains and make them do things, all without drugs. That is how Dylan Borland, a former Air Force man who speaks about secret UFO matters, describes the documents. If true, it would mean the government holds the power to rewrite what a person remembers.
